title: Hruday whole-sequence convergence and common limit of the named constructions
accepted: In the AM2/AQ1 zero-selected patterned family (model AQ_patterned_zero_selected: SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0) with Haar product reference, 21 omitted faces per anchor entering as -(tau/3)W_f in normalized units delta=alpha/8; both signs |tau|<=10^-8; AM2 creation expansion in each on-site cutoff space; cover R={0,e_z}; coarse l-infinity metric with star diameter 1 for states and l1 on the coarse factor lattice with F(r)=(1+r)^-4 for dynamics; trace norm on B(H_Y); clock theta=alpha t/hbar), with the named construction families F1 = AQ1 centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3 and F2 = I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N, N at least 2, with the BA2 gate dynamics constants, and with the BB1 hypotheses discharged by the BB1 gate (sha256 18141fea672e5bae09024a5fddc56ea7102aae56ecca16fbb30d67a1354a3827, accepted_within_scope), which admits for each of the five comparisons c1-c5 of the BB1 contract, at both signs, in each on-site cutoff space with constants independent of the cutoff and at fixed N for the untruncated ground vectors, the R form C q^(N-1) with q=1/64 and C about 8.9051e-07 (polymer_kp bound value; iterated_split 8.9043e-07), at most C_h=1/250000, and the region form c_site |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y} with c_site about 8.7681e-07 (iterated_split 8.7673e-07), at most c_h=1/500000, so that every hypothesis used by either route is discharged: For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, under the BB1 locality bounds at their frozen targets as hypotheses (discharged only when the BB1 gate admits constants at most those targets), the reduced densities of the named construction families F1 and F2 on centered coarse cubes converge as whole sequences, at a rate in N, to one common limit on every finite region; this limit coincides with every AQ1 subsequential limit and every F2 subsequential limit, is invariant under coarse translations, and has as correlation functions on |theta|<=8 the limits of the finite-box correlation functions; this is convergence of the named constructions, not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about states outside the named constructions, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a. Constants (exact; both signs; F1 and F2; in each on-site cutoff space uniformly in the cutoff and, at fixed N, for the untruncated ground vectors; evaluated at the hypothesis values as the contract target specifies, and valid under the discharge because each is nondecreasing in the BB1 constants). Item 1: sup over M greater than N of ||rho^{F,M}_R-rho^{F,N}_R||_1 <= C' q^(N-1) with C'=4/984375 (about 4.0635e-06; exact_first_order, nested_telescoping, hypothesis source bb1_frozen_targets, BB1 route polymer_kp; margin 315/128 against 1/100000), and for every finite complete-factor region Y inside Lambda_N, sup over M greater than N of ||rho^{F,M}_Y-rho^{F,N}_Y||_1 <= c'_site |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y} with d_Y=N-max_{y in Y}|y|_inf and c'_site=2/984375 (about 2.0317e-06; margin 315/128 against 1/200000); the union_comparison route proves C'=1/250000 and c'_site=1/500000 (labelled); re-evaluated at the admitted BB1 values (labelled, not bound), C' is about 9.0465e-07 and c'_site about 8.9073e-07 (nested_telescoping), about 8.9051e-07 and 8.7681e-07 (union_comparison). The limit on every finite region follows from this Cauchy bound and trace-class completeness, without compactness. Item 2: the F1 and F2 limits coincide on every finite region (BB1 comparison c3, the fixed-N comparison of the two prescriptions). Item 3: the limit equals every AQ1 subsequential limit (F1) and every F2 subsequential limit on every finite region and inherits exactly the admitted properties of those states: AQ1 stationarity under T_theta, strong continuity of the GNS evolution and a nonnegative generator (for F2 limits through BA2's rerun of AQ1 sections 4-5), and the AQ2 statement for the actual AQ1 centered subsequential state, H_phys at least (alpha/16)(I-P_Omega) with a simple vacuum on the invariant-local cyclic completion, the full-GNS strengthening only as qualified in the AQ2 gate. Item 4: for every coarse translation v (fine translation (4v_x,2v_y,v_z), preserving residues and face classes) and N at least |v|_inf+2, ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_h q^(N-|v|_inf-1) with C_h=1/250000 (the direct BB1 comparison c5 of two one-prescription volumes containing Lambda_{N-|v|_inf}; re-evaluated at the admitted C about 8.9051e-07, labelled; a two-step comparison through the union is labelled only), and the limit is invariant under coarse translations on every finite region (region form of c5); non-coarse translations are rejected. Item 5: for N at least 5, r_N=floor((N-1)/2), |theta| at most 8 and A in B(H_R), |c^{F,N}_A(theta)-c^inf_A(theta)| <= ||A||^2 [C_dyn/(r_N-1) + c'_site |Lambda_{r_N}| e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} q^(N-r_N) + 2C' q^(N-1)] with complex-mean centering, c^{F,N}_A(theta)=omega^{F,N}(A* T^{F,N}_theta(A))-|omega^{F,N}(A)|^2 and c^inf_A(theta)=omega_inf(A* T_theta(A))-|omega_inf(A)|^2, and C_dyn=78057/622883200000000 (about 1.2532e-10; polynomial_lieb_robinson, duhamel_inner_f1, 2K_F1+K_cmp/4 from the BA2 gate values, one constant for both families; margin about 3.99 against 1/2000000000); the reverse per-family values 9261/77860400000000 (F1, duhamel_inner_f1, about 1.1894e-10) and 1055961408185869563/15240701171875000000000000000 (F2, duhamel_inner_f2, about 6.9286e-11) are labelled. This inequality holds for every N at least 5. It gives an explicit rate in N only on the certified range 5<=N<=14000, where N |c^{F,N}_A(theta)-c^inf_A(theta)| <= K5 ||A||^2 with K5 about 6.10e-09 (about 5.96e-09 and 5.46e-09 with the reverse F1 and F2 constants); no O(1/N) rate is asserted beyond that range. The bracket stays below 2 up to N=14418 and is at least 2 at N=14419 and at every larger N, so the bound is vacuous from N=14419 (certified here at the hypothesis values and at the admitted values alike; the historical assistant-2 found the same first exceedance independently at the hypothesis values). The finite-box correlation functions converge to c^inf_A(theta) along the whole sequence of N, for every A in B(H_R) and |theta| at most 8, without a rate outside the certified range (the inequality with any fixed r in place of r_N gives a limsup of at most C_dyn/(r-1) ||A||^2). Labelled secondary at q_2=151552|tau| (592/390625 at the cap): C'_2=625/12481056 (about 5.0076e-05, target 1/8000) and c'_site,2=625/24962112 (about 2.5038e-05, no target), discharged by the BB1 secondary pair (C_2 about 9.689e-06 at most 1/20000 and c_site,2 about 9.674e-06 at most 1/40000, iterated_split bound values). The tau to tau/100 ratios are exactly 1 for C' and c'_site at the hypothesis values (non-discriminating), 1953058850/194651 (about 10033.64) for C_dyn and the reverse F1 value, about 10019.59 for the reverse F2 value, 1085053/1083425 (about 1.0015) for C'_2, and exactly 100 for q_2. Rates are per coarse step in N at fixed spacing.
limitations: Scope: only the zero-selected patterned family (selected triple (0,0,0), Haar reference), fixed spacing, |tau|<=10^-8, the named families F1 and F2 on centered cubes Lambda_N with N at least 2 and the limit of the named constructions, the cover R and finite complete-factor regions, coarse translations and the window |theta|<=8; nothing transfers to other boundary conditions, states outside the named constructions, nonzero selected triples, literal vertex boxes, weak coupling or the continuum; the constants are uniform in N at fixed spacing and in the cutoff, never in the lattice spacing.

Convergence of the named constructions only: no uniqueness of any ground state and no statement about any other infinite-volume state; the limit is identified only with the AQ1 and F2 subsequential limits and inherits only the listed admitted properties (the full-GNS strengthening only as qualified in the AQ2 gate); no equality of GNS dynamics of different states and no uniform-in-time statement.

Discharge: both routes prove items 1-5 from the BB1 frozen targets C_h=1/250000 and c_h=1/500000 at q=1/64 as hypotheses. The BB1 gate (sha256 18141fea672e5bae09024a5fddc56ea7102aae56ecca16fbb30d67a1354a3827, commit eef57b4) admits C about 8.9051e-07 and c_site about 8.7681e-07 for all five comparisons, both forms, both cutoff regimes and both signs. The skeptic discharge (the protocol committed in bb2_check.py before either producer or the gate was read, applied to the anchored admission record bb2-bb1-admission.json and cross-checked with the BB1 review table in 40 cells) finds every item full and every cell of both producers' hypothesis maps discharged. The bound constants are evaluated at the hypothesis values; the values re-evaluated at the admitted constants are labelled only.

The discharge carries the BB1 limitations: the polymer_kp bound values rest on the Kotecky-Preiss criterion, whose citation was checked post hoc against the committed Ueltschi excerpt and found covered; the self-contained iterated_split values discharge every item as well (labelled run). F2 volumes other than centred cubes in c5 (item 4) rest on the AY1 itemization as a reviewed local reading, not a gated statement.

Item-5 rate (reverse W1; skeptic defect D12): contract required item 5 says the rate in N is O(1/N), but with r_N and the region form frozen the region term on Lambda_{r_N} carries e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} with |Lambda_{r_N}| about N^3, which eventually outgrows q^(N-r_N). The rate holds only on the certified range 5<=N<=14000 and the bound is vacuous from N=14419, so that clause of the requirement is met on the certified range only. The skeptic's own pre-comparison derivation (section 8) stated the rate without the range, and its pre-freeze and pre-comparison reviews missed the defect; the reverse producer found it.

Rejected forward overclaim: the forward report's rate paragraph (the rate in N is O(1/N) while the state terms decay geometrically in N, the cube volume growing only like N^3) and the matching results text are rejected, because the region term is at least 2 from N=14419 on; the forward checker evaluates item 5 only for N<=59, and its enclosure e^x<=1/(1-x) is unusable from N=465. The forward's item-5 inequality and constants are correct; the frozen forward files are retained as evidence and the rejected wording enters no gate text.

Constants are upper bounds only; the minus-sign values replay the same |tau| formula. C' and c'_site at the hypothesis values do not depend on tau (ratio exactly 1, non-discriminating); the linear tau-scaling of the BB1 constants is recorded by BB1 (about 100.648). The dynamics constant is BA2's, and the correlation bound holds per fixed local A on |theta|<=8 only.

Contract wording read as follows: union_comparison is one direct application of c4 or c5 (a two-step comparison through a third volume is labelled, and the reverse's labelled item-4 fallback 2C_h is valid but looser than the available C_h(1+q^|v|)); C_dyn is bound as the forward's single-route constant with the reverse per-family values labelled (D3, D10); c'_site,2 has no target (D5); d_Y is the BB1 definition (D7); no frame for limited outcomes (D9, moot at this verdict); several inherited control texts were written for BA2 or BB1 (D6); the item-3 inheritance is read within the admitted scope (D4, D11).

Independence is limited to derivations, constants and code: all agents are correlated model agents; the frozen targets, the brackets and the conditional semantics came from the skeptic's BB pre-freeze review; the skeptic pre-comparison package was committed after the forward commit and before the reverse commit; isolation is verified for repository inputs only, and both producers disclosed name-only exposures to other agents' file names.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AQ_patterned_zero_selected) at both signs |tau|<=10^-8; construction families F1 (AQ1 centered whole-star boxes) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding) on centered coarse cubes Lambda_N, N at least 2, and their limit on every finite complete-factor region; states in trace norm on B(H_Y) with the coarse l-infinity metric; dynamics T_theta and T^{F,N}_theta with the l1 metric and F(r)=(1+r)^-4 on |theta| at most 8, theta=alpha t/hbar; each on-site cutoff space uniformly in the cutoff, then the untruncated ground vectors at fixed N; BB1 locality bounds as hypotheses discharged by the BB1 gate (sha256 18141fea672e5bae09024a5fddc56ea7102aae56ecca16fbb30d67a1354a3827)
decision: Admit convergence of the named constructions: the reduced densities of F1 and F2 converge as whole sequences (sup over all M greater than N) on every finite region, without compactness, to one common limit, the limit of the named constructions: sup_{M>N}||rho^{F,M}_R-rho^{F,N}_R||_1 <= C' q^(N-1) and sup_{M>N}||rho^{F,M}_Y-rho^{F,N}_Y||_1 <= c'_site |Y| e^{|Y|/10^8} q^{d_Y} with q=1/64, bound values C'=4/984375 (about 4.0635e-6) and c'_site=2/984375 (about 2.0317e-6), forward nested_telescoping over the hypotheses C_h=1/250000 and c_h=1/500000 (margin 315/128 against the frozen 1/100000 and 1/200000; exact_first_order tier; BB1 bound route polymer_kp), reverse union_comparison values C_h and c_h labelled; re-evaluated at the BB1 admitted constants (labelled): C' about 9.05e-7 forward, 8.91e-7 reverse. Every BB1 hypothesis used by either route is discharged by the BB1 gate item by item (comparison, form, cutoff regime, sign), and also by the self-contained iterated_split values alone. The limit coincides with every AQ1 subsequential limit and every F2 subsequential limit on every finite region and inherits exactly the admitted properties of those states (AQ1 stationarity under T_theta, strong continuity of the GNS evolution and a nonnegative generator; the AQ2 gap alpha/16 with a simple vacuum on the invariant-local cyclic completion, the full-GNS strengthening only as qualified in the AQ2 gate). Coarse translation invariance on every finite region, with ||rho^{Lambda_N+v}_R-rho^{Lambda_N}_R||_1 <= C_h q^(N-|v|_inf-1) for N at least |v|_inf+2 by the direct BB1 comparison c5; non-coarse translations rejected face by face (8 of 64 fine translations of a period window are symmetries, exactly the coarse ones). Correlation functions on |theta| at most 8: for N at least 5 and r_N=floor((N-1)/2), |c^{F,N}_A(theta)-c^inf_A(theta)| <= ||A||^2 [C_dyn/(r_N-1) + c'_site |Lambda_{r_N}| e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} q^(N-r_N) + 2C' q^(N-1)] with complex-mean centering and C_dyn=78057/622883200000000 (about 1.2532e-10; polynomial_lieb_robinson tier, route duhamel_inner_f1 for both families; margin about 3.99 against 1/2000000000); reverse per-family values labelled (F1 9261/77860400000000, F2 about 6.9286e-11, route duhamel_inner_f2); the new lemma (5N+1)(r_N-1) <= N^3/4 for N at least 5. The inequality holds for every N at least 5; it gives the rate K5/N only on the certified range 5 <= N <= 14000 (K5 about 6.10e-9) and is vacuous from N=14419 on because the frozen region factor e^{|Lambda_{r_N}|/10^8} eventually outgrows q^(N-r_N); the correlation functions converge along the whole sequence for every N without a rate. tau -> tau/100: C' and c'_site exactly 1 at the hypothesis values (non-discriminating, recorded), C_dyn about 10033.6 inside [9500,10500], secondary about 1.0015, q_2 exactly 100. Recorded: the forward's unqualified O(1/N) rate wording is rejected and enters no gate text (skeptic defect D12 against its own pre-comparison derivation); the forward's if-undischarged dynamics_level value lies outside the closed vocabulary (Jung assistant-2); the reverse's item-5 hypothesis map omits c3 for its F2 part (discharged under the corrected reading); the reverse's union fallback 2C_h is valid but looser than C_h(1+q^|v|); a replay output of the skeptic was written outside the checkout by an empty shell variable and disclosed. This is convergence of the named constructions to their common limit at a rate in N; it is not uniqueness of any ground state, not a statement about states outside the named constructions, not equality of GNS dynamics of different states, not uniform in time and not uniform in the lattice spacing a. Sub-round 2 complete.
